children: Practo elevates Shashank ND to MD and Executive Chairman, appoints Jagnoor Singh as CEO, Company says it is growing 40 per cent year-on-year and profitable

Practo, a digital healthcare platform, today announced a new leadership structure to support its next phase of growth. Shashank ND Singh, Founder and CEO, has been elevated to the expanded role of Managing Director and Executive Chairman. Jagnoor Singh, previously Chief Operating Officer, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective 01 September 2026. The company said it is growing at 40 per cent year-on-year and has remained profitable for the past two and a half years.

As Managing Director and Executive Chairman, Shashank ND Singh will shape Practo's overall vision, product and strategy and lead the company's long-term innovation agenda, capital strategy, inorganic growth and corporate development initiatives.
Shashank ND Singh said Practo has built a healthcare platform connecting patients, doctors and providers over the past 18 years.

Jagnoor Singh joined Practo as Chief Operating Officer in January 2025 and has spent close to two years driving the company's growth strategy, strengthening execution and advancing its expansion into new markets. Before Practo, Singh held senior operating roles at Bharti Airtel, Unacademy and OYO, spanning telecom and consumer internet. As CEO, he will lead Practo's overall strategy, growth and operations across global markets, working closely with Shashank ND to advance the company's long-term vision.
Jagnoor Singh said he has had the opportunity to help strengthen Practo's businesses and advance its global expansion since joining the company.
